messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for /v1/generate from hosted-prod in us-east-1 — 5xx rate 18% over 3m, paging oncall

maria (oncall): seeing it, joining now. can someone grab customer-impact? @product-ops

sam b: i'm on CI. quick check: dashboard shows spike at 12:41 UTC, correlated with a config rollout to ded-cpu-optimizer-3 at 12:40.

liam k: i can look at infra side, pulling logs from the runtime. ping me if you need me to flip traffic.

jessie r: tagging @legal for any potential customer notification if impact > 5% of requests

maria (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout 2) rollback optimizer config 3) enable fallback model v2-alpha for affected customer tiers. doing step 1 now.

infra-bot: Deploy job #4521 paused by maria (oncall) — rollback queued -> job #4522

sam b: rollback started, ETA ~2m. logs show `KV cache miss` spikes and repeated OOMs in worker-7. attaching snippet:```[worker-7] runtime: allocation failed: 2.1GB free, requested 3.6GB
stack: ...
```

liam k: that aligns with a kernel change in the optimizer that increases memory reservation. rolling back kernel patch on nodepool-optimizer.

maria (oncall): rollback complete. traffic shifted back to pre-optimizer config. monitoring.

product-ops: customer-impact estimate: ~6% of requests in us-east-1 experienced latency >5s or 5xxs between 12:40-12:49 UTC. top impacted customers: Acme, PrismLabs (heavy embedding usage).

jessie r: creating a short incident channel for follow-up notes. will schedule a post-incident readout.

maria (oncall): immediate mitigation OK. need evidence collection for RCA: 1) full logs for worker-7 12:30-13:00 2) rollout config diff 3) metric series for kv-cache-hit, p95 latency, 5xx-rate

sam b: collecting logs now and saving to s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1765432100/ — uploading artifacts: `worker7.log`, `optimizer-config-diff.json`, `metrics.csv`.

infra-bot: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1765432100/worker7.log (4.1MB), optimizer-config-diff.json (3.2KB), metrics.csv (120KB)

maria (oncall): nice. next: post-incident. Jess, can you own scheduling the postmortem and drafting the timeline? suggest 1-hour sync tomorrow.

jessie r: I’ll own the post-incident slate. proposed time: tomorrow 16:00 UTC. will add agenda: timeline, root cause hypotheses, customer impact, action items, owner assignment.

liam k: I can draft the contributing-factor section (kernel memory reservation + missing safety gate in rollout). Sam — can you add logs timeline and exact request ids for impacted customers?

sam b: yes, will annotate logs with request ids and attach a sample replay. note: we saw repeated `cache_rebuild` tasks concurrent with optimizer ramp-up.

product-ops: I'll prepare a short customer impact blurb (for CSMs) and a timeline so we can quickly notify affected customers once we finalize RCA.

legal: please flag if we need to escalate communications. based on current impact (~6%) probably a standard notification, not a regulatory escalation. will review final wording.

maria (oncall): action items (quick capture):
- sam b: upload annotated logs + sample replay (owner) — due EOD today
- liam k: prepare infra root cause draft + mitigation checklist — due before postmortem
- jessie r: schedule postmortem + draft timeline — invites sent
- product-ops: draft customer impact note — due before postmortem
- infra: add rollout safety-gate to CI (blocker on mem spike > threshold) — P0 ticket

jessie r: invites sent to: maria (oncall), sam b, liam k, product-ops, legal. channel for postmortem: #postmortem-1765432100 (will be private until signoff).

sam b: uploading annotated logs now -> done. link: s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1765432100/annotated-logs.json

liam k: uploaded infra draft -> s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1765432100/infra-rationale.md. short tl;dr: optimizer changed kernel allocation semantics -> memory headroom miscomputed for certain sequence lengths. missing live-traffic canary checks allowed rollout to progress.

maria (oncall): thanks. plan for RCA writeup: I’ll assemble timeline + evidence, Liam writes contributing factors, Sam provides logs+replays, Jess will collect action items and owners, Product will write customer impact section. After draft ready, we’ll do 24h peer review and then legal sign-off for any customer comms.

product-ops: draft impact note attached -> s3://redwood-incident-evidence/1765432100/customer-impact.md (short summary + affected accounts).

legal: will review postmortem once draft is in #postmortem-1765432100. if any PIIs show up in logs, redact before sharing externally.

maria (oncall): rough timeline to include in RCA: detection 12:40 UTC, rollout start 12:39, errors spike 12:41, rollback initiated 12:42, rollback complete 12:44, degraded tail until 12:49. include metric plots.

jessie r: noted. I’ll open the RCA draft doc and drop links to artifacts. target: draft ready for peer review within 12 hours.

sam b: quick note for the RCA timeline — include the command used to pause rollout:```curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/job/4521/pause -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'```

maria (oncall): agreement: after peer review we’ll mark the doc P1-signed and create follow-up tickets for infra and devex to implement the safety gate and to add better memory telemetry on optimizer kernels.

product-ops: after sign-off, I'll send a customer notification to impacted accounts with proposed remediation credit (TBD).

jessie r: closing loop: do we need a follow-on incident drill to verify new safety gate? propose a chaos test next week once fix is in staging.

liam k: +1 to chaos test. I'll own a staging test plan and post results in the postmortem thread.

maria (oncall): ok thanks everyone. if anything new appears, re-open here. otherwise we’ll move discussion to #postmortem-1765432100 and mark this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
